services.name: Facilities and Rentals
services.desc: Looking for a place to host your next event, meeting, or activity? The City of Camrose offers a variety of facilities and rental spaces to suit your needs. The Camrose Recreation Centre features three indoor rinks available for seasonal programs, team practices, tournaments, and private ice rentals. The Community Centre offers a versatile multi-purpose floor suitable for a variety of indoor sports and recreational activities, including basketball, soccer, floor hockey, badminton, volleyball, pickleball, and tennis.
